summary.text: Darius Kila represents House District 44 (Māʻili, Lualualei, Nānākuli, Honokai Hale and Ko Olina) in the Hawaii House of Representatives and was elected in 2022.

paragraphs.text: Before his election Kila was Community Liaison for Representative Stacelynn Eli and held leadership roles on the Nānākuli-Māʻili Neighborhood Board.

Kila graduated from Kapolei High School and studied at Lane College, Fullerton College, and Southern Oregon University; his legislature biography states that he chairs the House Committee on Transportation.
